blurb: Guests join Captain Robert Douglas on fishing charters targeting species like Striped Bass, Bluefin Tuna, Yellowfin Tuna, White Marlin, and more. Trips include offshore, inshore, canyon fishing, and sunset cruises. The vessel is a 32 ft Everglades center console equipped for offshore fishing and comfort.
extraNote: $200 deposit required at booking · Cancellations must be made 10 days prior to trip for deposit refund · If captain cancels due to weather, will attempt to reschedule or refund deposit · Tips not included, industry standard 20% · Drinking alcohol allowed if responsible; no drugs allowed · Sakonnet Harbor in Little Compton, Rhode Island
